headline: Transforming Engineering with Multiphysics Simulation and AI to Power the Future of Energy
about:
Simulation Engineer | AI Enthusiast | Digital Engineering

Passionate about leveraging simulation and artificial intelligence to solve complex engineering challenges.
My work focuses on applying physics-based modeling, numerical methods, and AI-driven approaches to improve product development, optimize performance, and enable informed engineering decisions. I am particularly interested in bridging traditional simulation techniques with emerging AI technologies to create smarter, faster, and more scalable engineering workflows.
With experience across computational engineering, digital engineering and optimization I enjoy transforming complex physical phenomena into actionable insights. I believe simulation and AI are key enablers of next-generation engineering, helping organizations reduce development time, improve product performance, and accelerate innovation.

My goal is simple: make engineering faster, smarter, and more predictive through Simulation and AI.

experience.description:
Predictive Simulations with PhysicsAI: Accelerate Design Decisions with AI

Development of an End-to-End Simulation Workflow for the Casting Industry:
This project focuses on the creation of an integrated and efficient simulation-driven workflow tailored for the casting industry (manufacturing solutions). PhysicsAI is utilized to enhance the predictive performance of the casting simulation process.

Topology Optimisation in Optistruct:
The objective is to enhance structural performance while minimizing material usage, ultimately contributing to lightweight design and improved fuel efficiency without compromising safety or functionality.

Master Thesis: To accelerate the battery simulation process for crash and impact test using ML.

- The objective of this thesis was to predict internal short circuits in batteries under crash conditions. 
- A thermo-mechanical single-cell model was developed in Radioss for a single-point indentation test. This model was then utilized to generate datasets based on various design variables, with the entire process being fully automated using HyperStudy. 
- PhysicsAI, an Altair tool leveraging Graph Neural Networks (GNN) for predictive modeling, was employed to train a machine learning model to predict strain distributions within the battery model. The predicted strain values were subsequently validated against real-time experimental test results. 
- By using the thermo-mechanical framework, strain and temperature profiles were mapped, effectively illustrating the occurrence of internal short circuits within the battery system.

receivedRecommendations.givenByHeadline: Accelerating CAE with AI | PreSales Solutions Consultant – Simcenter Mechanical, PhysicsAI, and Surrogate Modeling
receivedRecommendations.description:
Ich hatte die Gelegenheit, im PreSales-Umfeld für CAE-Software eng mit Mayur zusammenzuarbeiten. Dabei habe ich ihn als äußerst kompetenten und sehr zuverlässigen Kollegen kennengelernt, auf den man sich jederzeit verlassen kann.
Mayur bringt eine beeindruckende Expertise im Bereich Surrogate Modeling und PhysicsAI mit und hat mir bei zahlreichen Fragestellungen schnell und fundiert weitergeholfen. Ebenso verfügt er über eine sehr solide und praxisnahe Erfahrung in der Struktursimulation (FEA), was ihn in vielen Diskussionen besonders wertvoll macht.
Was ich besonders schätze, ist seine Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Inhalte klar und zielgerichtet zu vermitteln und gleichzeitig den Bezug zur konkreten Kundenanwendung nicht zu verlieren. Er denkt lösungsorientiert und bringt die richtigen Punkte auf den Tisch.
Die Zusammenarbeit mit Mayur war durchweg sehr positiv, und ich kann ihn als technischen Experten und Sparringspartner klar weiterempfehle
